test: a quantity outside 1 to 20 asks again
mutation: Named test 6: the settle rule 5 check never fires, so an out-of-bound quantity is dropped instead of asked about.

edits.old: if ([...asked.values()].some((quantity) => !suggestedQuantity(quantity))) return clarify(["item"]);
edits.new: if (asked.size > MAX_MATCHES * 100) return clarify(["item"]);

test: a quantity outside 1 to 20 asks again
mutation: Named mutation for test 6: an out-of-bound quantity is clamped into 1-20 and rounded, which is exactly the clamped basket settle rule 5 forbids.

edits.old: if ([...asked.values()].some((quantity) => !suggestedQuantity(quantity))) return clarify(["item"]);
edits.new: for (const [id, quantity] of asked) if (!suggestedQuantity(quantity)) asked.set(id, Math.min(MAX_SUGGESTED_QUANTITY, Math.max(1, Math.round(quantity))));
